description: T2.6a check 4: a 30-degree sun step (the light and the procedural sky together) on the furnished room, by re-tracing alone, GI only: each bookmark's view within 5% of settled (mean and per pixel), the step's size, and the whole volume's light-weighted error. VITE_DDGI_UNITS sets the batch, VITE_DDGI_BOOKMARKS the views (1-based). Needs the furnished-room download.
